title: Machine admission, shared capacity and retirement
situations: Make a machine available to other operators.
Retire or reconnect a machine after credentials change.
current: Source connects an own machine through a match code approved from an existing connection, or a teammate machine through the teammate's private invite. Setup also offers an explicit existing API token for first boot or recovery. Back/Esc before submission preserves connection config; lost invite delivery names reissue and stray-machine retirement. Active local connections show reachability and self-host guidance before remote admission. Live proof remains pending.
questions: Does machine retirement explain effects on running sessions and outstanding custody?
